text:
```yaml
name: E2E Tests
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "**"
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
      - "website/**"
      - "docs/**"
      - "examples/**"
      - "ui"

jobs:
  e2e:
    name: E2E Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 1.23.1
        id: go

      - name: Check out code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bats jq curl

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build -t dkron:test .

      - name: Start test cluster
        run: |
          docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: |
          timeout 120s bash -c 'while ! curl -sf http://localhost:8080/v1/health > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done'
          make e2e

      - name: Collect container logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml logs

      - name: Clean up resources
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v
```
